name: Business Ladders
description: Eight Business tests rebuilt as ten-rung difficulty ladders (not the Business Ladder's adoption levels): invoices, payslips, expenses, reconciliation, the customer list, contract changes, database questions and the support queue. On each rung more of the answer depends on earlier work; a rung is passed at 90% of its points. What the November 2026 blind test found: today's top models clear these ladders (96-100% on every level tested, up to level 9), so they do not pick out the cleverest top model. They show which models stay error-free as the work piles up, and where smaller, cheaper models start to slip. The headline is the ladder height alongside the Business Score. Every answer is machine-checked against a solver. Never mixed into the Gauntlet Index.
